labels_caveat: 'Good Health' comes from a different dataset (FETAL_PLANES_ZENODO) than 'Med'/'Bad Health' (HASH Maternal Health.coco), and the Med/Bad boundary is applied from pathology names in filenames rather than read from the data - the COCO source has one label, 'abnormal', and no severity field. Run Tests/dataset_integrity_test.py to see how much of the accuracy above is available without reading any anatomy.
